title: The Rock | 6BR Gulf Front Grayton Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The Rock is a luxury 6BR Gulf-front Grayton Beach home with a private pool and movie room. This 30A rental sleeps 20 by Royal Destinations. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: The Rock (formerly Firenze) by Royal Destinations Location: Gulf Front Grayton Beach Address: 544 Defuniak Street, Santa Posa Beach, FL Details: Welcome to The Rock, formerly known as Firenze. Stay at this fully remodeled custom-designed, gulf-front home in historic Grayton Beach and experience the most stunning 250-degree vista in Grayton! This sought after destination offers everything imaginable to the most discerning guest. This entire home has been upgraded from the ground floor like new construction. Each accommodation is well thought out to offer a vacation of a lifetime. Sunrises and sunsets will be as picturesque as any movie backdrop while the architecture and interior details of the home, along with its location are captivating! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front -6300 Sq Ft -Parking Spaces: 8 -Dining Accommodations -*Private Heated Pool *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 20 6 Bedrooms / 6 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths / 1 Outdoor Shower Ground Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: Four Queen/Queen Bunks - Two Full Private Bathrooms - Foyer, Movie Room with Bar, Exercise Room, Elevator, Half Bath Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed, Private Bath - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bath - Guest Bedroom 4: King Bed, Private Bath - Pool / Entertainment Room, Pool Deck and Lounge Chairs - Half Bath - Panoramic Gulf Front Views Third Floor: - Primary Bedroom 5: King Bed - Guest Bedroom 6: King Bed, Private Bath - Dining Room, Open Vaulted Great Room, Chef’s Kitchen - Panoramic Gulf Front Views - Half Bath Fourth Floor: - Loft, Panoramic Gulf Front Views - Queen Daybed - Full bath Amenities Include: -8 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
